# DormChef

DormChef helps college students import recipes from supported links or recipe screenshots, plan meals, and build an organized grocery list directly from that plan. Costs are estimates. Roommates can combine lists for a shared shopping run. Shopping options and transfers vary by retailer; final prices and checkout belong to the retailer.

The app is being prepared with student feedback. Product updates: https://dormchefllc.com/.
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dormchef_official/.
Contact: dormchef.app@gmail.com.
Privacy: https://dormchefllc.com/privacy.html
